title: EFC adversarial review finding
description: A single machine-readable finding from one reviewer in the 9-agent adversarial review. CLOSED by design (C10): an invented key without a registry fails. Every finding carries its evidence layer, so paradigm/consensus can never masquerade as raw signal or normative source. Agents write proposed_status; they have NO status field — the binding status lives only in the verdict's human_gate block, written by a human.

method_revision.description: Protocol revision. The release gate compares numerically (>= v2), never by equality, so a future v3 must not break the check. v1 = pre-paradigm-neutrality pilot (frozen history, not a release gate).

evidence_layer.description: Where this finding's claim comes from. PARADIGM/PREVIOUS_AGENT/HINDSIGHT/AUTHOR/HYPOTHESIS can never alone ground a promotion — enforced mechanically by efc_review_gate.py.

atlas_node_ref.description: A node id in schema/regime_nodes.jsonld, when this finding maps to one.

atlas_field.description: The atlas FIELD this finding maps to (e.g. maale_paradigme, epistemikk, measure). A value, never a schema key — the Norwegian atlas field names stay out of the English machine contract.

source.description: The primary source this finding is grounded in.

reasoning.description: The reviewer's reasoning, always in prose — kept distinct from the machine-enforceable fields so a phrase can never be mistaken for a binding check.

required_text_change.description: The exact text change a reviewer demands, or null. Only meaningful when disposition is accepted.

disposition.description: The meta-reviewer's classification of this finding (round 3). Null until a meta-reviewer disposes of it. The release gate requires a non-null disposition on every finding in a verdict.

proposed_status.description: Agent PROPOSAL for claim status. Never binding; never the ledger value.
